limits: One seed per run and twelve observed draws, with seed 09 exceeding the one-hour notice in a separate diagnostic set. Fresh accepted runs must independently reproduce the delayed-start classification. Descriptive sample statistics do not establish the underlying probability law, full tail, independence, other J01 variants or cross-engine equivalence.
